description.value: Farm Gate Store is an independent, community-rooted grocery on Mayne Island, one of the Gulf Islands, open since April 2011 and founded by farmer-and-chef owners Don and Shanti. It stocks organic and locally sourced produce, artisan cheeses, specialty foods, and eco-friendly household goods, with a daily deli counter turning out chef-made sandwiches, entrees, and hot meals using in-season local ingredients. For cyclists ferrying through the Gulf Islands, it offers one of the most complete fresh-food stops available on Mayne Island.
